oracle.population_unique.note: Single summary row (population, max occurrences, duplicates).

oracle.distinct_per_subject.note: One row per determinant/subject group with a distinct count. Selects groups, not their member rows.

oracle.related_existence.note: Returns rows of the subject relation. The subject is supplied by group-specific tags (e.g. source_schema/source_table, node_query), not {{schema_name}}.{{table_name}}.

oracle.join_match_count.note: Source rows plus profile_match_count; subject is {{source_schema}}.{{source_table}}.

oracle.relationship_degree.note: Single summary row of degree maxima.

oracle.population_coverage.note: Single summary row of covered/missing counts.

oracle.category_frequency_profile.note: One row per category with frequency and share.

oracle.numeric_population_statistics.note: Final SELECT is the [[selection]] slot. S04 selects the summary row (measure); S03 selects source rows with statistics attached (overridden to partition).

oracle.aligned_numeric_aggregate_compari.note: Single summary row comparing two aggregates.

oracle.category_representation_intervals.note: Final SELECT is the [[selection]] slot: H05 returns one row per domain category, H06 one balance summary row. Both measure.

oracle.reference_pair_filter.note: UNCERTAIN: returns t.* joined to matching reference rows, so a source row appears once per matched reference record (pair grain). Drilling in may therefore contain duplicated source rows.

oracle.evaluable_agreement.note: Rows of the investigator-supplied input query plus profile_agreement; a partition of the node only if that query selects from the node source.

oracle.extract_union_counts.note: One row per key with source/target occurrence counts.

oracle.unique_extract_agreement.note: UNCERTAIN: one row per matched key with investigator-chosen comparison_output_columns, not source rows. Could act as a partition only if the output columns are the full source row.

oracle.graph_cycle_participation.note: UNCERTAIN: returns a list of node_id values (one row per distinct node), not source rows.

oracle.graph_rooted_reachability.note: UNCERTAIN: returns a list of node_id values (one row per distinct node), not source rows.

oracle.graph_shortest_depth.note: One row per reachable node with its depth.

oracle.metadata_set_difference.note: Single summary row of added/removed counts.

oracle.component_truth_aggregation.note: Rows of {{subject_query}} plus component counts; subject_query must expose a subject_id column.

S03.1.note: Selection returns source rows (v.*) with mean/SD attached; the template default is measure.

S03.2.note: Selection returns source rows (v.*) with mean/SD attached; the template default is measure.

P02.note: Heuristic says table (no column tag); missingness is a rule about one column's values, as §6 notes.

P05.note: sentinel_set_query supplies a declared value list, not another relation of records.

C01.note: Rule spans several fields of the record.

C02.note: Heuristic says table. Definition is about one selected column's presence; missing_condition is written against that column.

C03.note: Heuristic says table. About one required field, conditioned on a row-level rule.

C04.note: Heuristic says table. Definition is about one selected column's presence; missing_condition is written against that column.

C05.note: Rule spans several fields of the record.

U02.note: Composite tuple spanning several columns; key_columns is left for the investigator (column tags do not fill on table groups).

U04.note: Single column or composite key. On a column, key_columns fills with that column; the investigator can override for a composite key.

U07.note: Single column or composite key. On a column, key_columns fills with that column; the investigator can override for a composite key.

M03.note: allowed_set_query is a declared domain list; the relational version (reference table) is K01.

F05.note: Checksum column and expected-hash column are on the same row; anchor on the value column.

N07.note: Heuristic says cross-source (source_value tag). source_value is an expression on the same row, not another relation.

N08.note: Heuristic says cross-source (source_value tag). source_value is an expression on the same row, not another relation.

R01.note: Heuristic says cross-source (reference_value tag). reference_value is a literal, not another relation.

R06.note: Heuristic says cross-source (reference_value tag). reference_value is a literal, not another relation.

D03.note: Up to six separate component columns (required_component_1..6).

D05.note: Heuristic says table. About one timestamp column; timezone_evidence_expression may reference a companion column on the same row.

T06.note: deadline_column is on the same row; anchor on the event column.

T07.note: Heuristic says table. Column pair (start_column, end_column) on the same row; attached to a column so Timestamp/Duration filtering applies. Neither column tag is auto-filled.

K02.note: Reference-side key column. Subject is {{reference_schema}}.{{reference_table}}; the source population is the other relation.
